It is the governing board of a private fellowship (a society), a real class whose membership rules each society sets for itself and no held rule fixes, so a minimum age of 40 contradicts nothing.

notes: TBox expansion, paired with people-replace-0019. Keeps the revision's relation (has_minimum_age) and new conclusion (at least 40 years old) and gives it to a made-up body, the board of the Ostrelund Fellowship, under the real class of governing boards of private societies, whose entry rules each society sets itself, so no inherited default is overridden and no old value is pushed out. The earlier version put a made-up parish council under local councils, where members need only be 18, which overrode inherited knowledge. The derived queries name invented board members with the membership stated in the prompt (inheritance, 2 hops, bridge in the prompt): the inserted rule is their only route to the age. The near unrelated query asks the real minimum age for a United States Senator, which must stay 30; a method that learned a bare 'office-holder must be 40' mapping would leak there. Board and member names are invented; the counting step records that they are absent from the corpus. Side facts and checks are those of the paired revision.
